notes.title: Road To Early Access v3
notes.content:
We're thrilled to bring you another significant update on our journey towards Early Access! This time, we've tackled major bottlenecks to ensure Elusive Verge not only looks better but also runs smoother than ever before. Get ready for an enhanced gaming experience with key improvements and exciting new content!

Key Updates Include:

Energy Projectiles Refined: We've fixed a pesky issue affecting the performance of some energy projectiles, ensuring they now function seamlessly.
Navigation Overhaul: On-board navigation has received a critical fix, smoothing out your journey across the cosmos.
Tutorial Missions Complete: The tutorial missions are now finished, offering a comprehensive introduction to the wonders and dangers of space exploration.
World Expansion: We've injected even more content into the world, enriching your adventure with new discoveries around every corner.
UI Performance Boost: Expect a smoother interface interaction with significant improvements to UI performance.
DLSS Frame Generation: An option for enabling DLSS Frame Generation has been added, taking visual fidelity and performance to new heights.
Advanced Graphics Support: Handling for FSR2 and DLSS3.5 is now optimized, ensuring top-tier visual quality across a wider range of systems.
CPU Load Reduction: We've reduced CPU overload globally, leading to a more efficient and responsive gameplay experience.
Lighting Enhancements: The lighting in Elusive Verge has been improved A LOT, creating a more immersive and visually stunning universe.


[center]Thank you for your support and feedback as we continue shaping Elusive Verge into the ultimate space exploration experience. Dive in now to explore the latest improvements![/center]

[center]#RoadToEarlyAccess #ElusiveVergeUpdate[/center]

notes.title: Road to Early Access v2
notes.content:
We're ecstatic to share that our latest update for Elusive Verge is now live!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41867748/1e225471ed4adf8c40b5cce607932765eff56577.png

In this update, we've honed in on several key aspects of the game to enhance your experience in the cosmos.

What's New:

 Guided Journeys: A revamped Tutorial/Objective Path Guidance system to navigate the stars more smoothly.
 Missile Mastery: Upgraded missile handling for a more dynamic combat experience.
 Visual Enhancements: Refreshed loading screens to make waiting times an exploration of the cosmos.
 Seamless Continuity: An improved saving system for flawless progress retention.
 Celestial Beauty:  Enhanced Moon visuals, bringing the celestial bodies to life like never before.
 Optimized Performance: Better FSR/DLSS handling for impeccable image quality and smoother gameplay.


We're committed to continuously improving Elusive Verge and can't wait for you to experience these updates. As always, we thank you for your support and look forward to hearing your feedback!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41867748/77eaca3901ce1564fbfcf2930272a704030a7715.jpg

notes.title: Road to Early Access v1
notes.content:
As we journey towards Early Access, our team is committed to enhancing the developer's build with daily improvements to ensure a seamless and engaging experience for all our players.

In our latest update, we are excited to announce that we've tackled the performance issues that led to significant FPS drops. After rigorous testing, including on the Steam Deck, we're now achieving a stable 60FPS—a key milestone in our optimization efforts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41867748/34119767d06df47ed62737c06d7f9ffa1bf57a45.png

Additionally, we've revitalized the environments surrounding the Diplomacy Nexus, infusing them with more depth and immersion. For our developers and testers, we've also introduced a suite of cheats designed to streamline the testing process and enrich your experience as we refine the game.

Stay tuned for more updates as we progress, and thank you for your continued support and feedback!

If you're eager to be a part of the thrilling journey behind creating Elusive Verge, we invite you to join our Patreon community and begin contributing today!
